_comment: Written and committed BEFORE the code it judges exists. The commit that adds this file
contains no implementation of anything it names.
This profile judges ONE sub-contract of Managed Alpha R2: what the service KEEPS. Redaction,
data minimisation, retention, deletion per account and per run, export, backup and restore,
and the attribution of metered use to an account, a policy version, a worker and a run in a
way that cannot be altered without the alteration being visible.
Deletion and tamper-evidence pull against each other. A profile that judged only one of them
would be passed by a system that had quietly abandoned the other, so both are here and the
criterion that reconciles them is blocking.
A pass concerns this sub-contract only. It is not authorisation to expose anything, release,
deploy, take payment, buy a domain or buy infrastructure.
review_object: What the managed sandbox retains: the redaction applied to logs, audit, refusals and any operator-facing surface; what is collected at all; configurable retention per class of record; deletion of an account and of a single run; export; a backup and restore procedure that has been executed; and the metering record that attributes use to an account, an operator policy version, a worker and a run.
out_of_scope: tenancy and cross-account isolation, which are judged by alpha-r2-tenancy-r1
admission, quotas and the narrowing rule, which are judged by alpha-r2-admission-r1
the choice of a payment provider and any price, which are founder decisions and must not appear
public exposure, release, deployment, domains, new infrastructure or new running costs
verdict_must_state: A pass concerns this code, its tests and the measurements presented, and nothing else. The gateway holds the key it signs its own metering with, so this can establish that nobody WITHOUT that key can alter the record undetectably, and cannot establish that the gateway is honest. This is not authorisation to expose anything, to deploy, or to charge for it.
roles_rule: Any input this profile does not list defaults to the lowest authority, 'context'. A request may name this profile and may not extend it.

criteria.text: Judge whether any credential, pairing code, session identifier, enrolment ticket, signing key, certificate private half, or any part of a job artifact or output can reach a log line, an audit line, a metering line, a refusal message, an exception, a URL, a health or metrics answer, a console screen, a backup or an export. Determine whether this is established by a test that PLANTS each of those shapes and asserts it never appears anywhere the gateway writes, or by reading the call sites; and whether a field added later would be covered by construction. State every place a caller-supplied value can still reach persistent storage.

Judge what the service collects and stores about a person and a job, field by field, and whether each is needed for something the service actually does. Determine whether a job output is stored longer than a caller needs to collect it; whether anything is stored that exists only because it was convenient; and whether the documentation states what is kept in terms a customer could check against the files on disk.

Judge whether each class of record has a retention period an operator can set, whether expiry is enforced by something that runs rather than by a documented intention, and what happens to a class with no configured period. Determine whether an unreadable retention configuration causes indefinite retention or a refusal, whether sweeping is idempotent and crash-safe, and whether a sweep that could not complete is visible rather than silent.

Judge deletion of one account and of one run. Determine what is actually removed, what survives, and why each survivor is justified; whether deletion reaches every store including the ledger, the audit, the metering chain, sessions, enrolments, invitations, counters and any cached or exported copy; and how deletion is reconciled with a hash chain that exists to prove nothing was removed. Determine specifically whether the reconciliation preserves the ability to detect an UNAUTHORISED removal, or whether it hands anybody who can delete a way to remove a line invisibly. State what a deletion leaves behind that could still identify a person.

Judge whether each metered line binds the run, the account, the operator policy version and digest, the worker and the ceilings it was admitted under, and whether any of those can be absent, empty or supplied by a caller. Determine whether editing, removing, reordering, truncating, forking or re-signing the record is detected and by what; what the detection costs an attacker who does not hold the key; and whether a statement derived from the record refuses to be produced when the record does not verify. State plainly what this does NOT establish.

Judge whether a restore has actually been performed rather than documented. Determine what was backed up, what was destroyed, what was restored, and what was checked afterwards -- specifically whether the metering chain still verifies, whether paired devices still work, whether the gateway still refuses what it refused before, and whether any secret was weakened or duplicated by the round trip. Determine whether the procedure is re-runnable by somebody who was not there, and whether a partial or failed restore is detected rather than producing a gateway that looks fine.

Judge what an export contains and who can obtain one. Determine whether it is scoped to one account, whether it can carry another account data, whether it can carry a credential or a secret, whether producing one is itself recorded, and whether the format is something a customer can read without this software.

Judge the presented tests and counter-checks rather than the claims. For each property, determine whether the counter-check removes that one mechanism, names a DIFFERENT test, shows it failing with a non-zero exit, proves the revert landed, and proves the file was restored. Determine whether any presented count was reconciled by hand rather than read from a machine-produced report, and whether any duration is offered as proof rather than as diagnosis.
